version.changelog: Replace Node CLI examples with tested Python MCP examples, including safe result handling and explicit API costs.

llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed FlashData Google Images connector that sends search requests and an API key to FlashData as expected, with no hidden or destructive behavior found.

dimensions.detail: Network access to https://data.flashdata.dev/mcp and transmission of the API key and search arguments are necessary for the hosted service, but users should avoid sensitive queries and understand that paid credits may be consumed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed as a ClawHub skill plus pinned Python dependencies, and use requires a FLASHDATA_API_KEY stored in the execution environment or secret manager.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells agents to run only user-requested queries within the approved budget, not execute examples automatically, avoid automatic paid retries, and treat retrieved content as untrusted source material.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, privilege escalation, tool hijacking, or background local service installation was found; optional async jobs are provider-side and documented.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Google Images search through hosted FlashData MCP, and the instructions, schema, and example requests all align with that capability.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this skill only if you are comfortable sending image search terms and your FlashData API key to FlashData. Store the key in protected environment settings, watch paid credit usage, avoid sensitive search queries, and check source-page licenses before reusing images.
llm.findings:
[E1] expected: The external FlashData endpoint is prominently disclosed and is the core mechanism for the hosted image search service; the artifact says only the API key and tool arguments are sent there.
[SQP-1] expected: The locale fields gl and hl are somewhat broad, but they are ordinary search parameters with length and pattern constraints, and the skill explains to set them only when country or language matters.
